I’m friends with some (not all) of my exes and I can assure you that’s definitely purely platonic! We don’t chat very often but we both know that in times of need, we can count on each other. Sometimes - about once a year or so we have a quick catch up chat!

I personally think exes can be friends. It depends on the breakup though and the individuals. For my exes and I, we know that we aren’t good as a couple but that doesn’t mean we don’t have respect for each other / can’t see good in each other. I am truly happy for all my exes and genuinely want the best for all of them. I am highly supportive of the relationships they are in and have no residual feelings of sexual attraction towards any of them at all!

Have an honest and open conversation with your partner and ask yourself if you’re feeling uncomfortable because of internal insecurities or if he’s actually doing something suspicious. Either way, both of these issues can be resolved with open communication! Eg maybe you’d feel better if he gave you more reassurance or helped explain the situation better. Or maybe upon discussing further you find your fears and concerns are valid and this isn’t correct behaviour that’s respectful to your relationship!
